title: An LLM-based multi-agent system to assist early-stage product design and evaluation
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The paper introduces DesignAgent, an LLM-based multi-agent system for early-stage product design and evaluation. It features agents that interpret requirements, generate 3D prototypes, and evaluate feasibility through FEA. The system was validated through a case study involving 104 simulated design sessions and a user study with 12 participants.
